import json
D=json.load(open('/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0-u1-ceiling/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-057e5e0d.json'))

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    # divider cells: color whose every occurrence is in a full uniform row or col
    full=[[all(g[i][j]==g[i][0] for j in range(w)) for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    fullc=[[all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] for i in range(h)) for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    linecells={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if full[i][j] or fullc[i][j]}
    div_colors={c for c in cnt if all((i,j) in linecells for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==c)}
    isdiv=[[g[i][j] in div_colors for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    # pattern block: contiguous non-divider block containing a non-background cell
    nonbg=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if not isdiv[i][j] and g[i][j]!=0]
    # choose most common non-divider color as background reference
    rest=Counter(g[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if not isdiv[i][j])
    bg=rest.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if not isdiv[i][j] and g[i][j]!=bg]
    i0,j0=min(i for i,j in seeds),min(j for i,j in seeds)
    i1,j1=max(i for i,j in seeds),max(j for i,j in seeds)
    pat=[row[j0:j1+1] for row in g[i0:i1+1]]
    ph,pw=len(pat),len(pat[0])
    return [[g[i][j] if isdiv[i][j] else pat[i%ph][j%pw] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]

for k,pair in enumerate(D):
    r=transform(pair['input'])
    print(k, r==pair['output'])
print(transform([[5,5,5],[5,5,5],[8,8,8],[7,7,5],[5,4,5]]))

prog='''def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    fullrows=[i for i in range(h) if all(g[i][j]==g[i][0] for j in range(w))]
    fullcols=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] for i in range(h))]
    linecells={(i,j) for i in fullrows for j in range(w)} | {(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in fullcols}
    div={c for c in cnt if all((i,j) in linecells for i,j in [(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==c])}
    drows=[i for i in fullrows if g[i][0] in div]
    dcols=[j for j in fullcols if g[0][j] in div]
    def runs(n,div_):
        r=[];s=None
        for i in range(n+1):
            if i<n and i not in div_:
                if s is None: s=i
            else:
                if s is not None: r.append((s,i-1)); s=None
        return r
    rruns=runs(h,set(drows)); cruns=runs(w,set(dcols))
    rest=Counter(g[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if i not in drows and j not in dcols)
    bg=rest.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if i not in drows and j not in dcols and g[i][j]!=bg]
    pb=[rr for rr in rruns if any(rr[0]<=i<=rr[1] for i,j in seeds)][0]
    cb=[cr for cr in cruns if any(cr[0]<=j<=cr[1] for i,j in seeds)][0]
    pat=[g[i][cb[0]:cb[1]+1] for i in range(pb[0],pb[1]+1)]
    ph,pw=len(pat),len(pat[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r0,r1 in rruns:
        for c0,c1 in cruns:
            if (r0,c0)==(pb[0],cb[0]): continue
            for i in range(r0,r1+1):
                for j in range(c0,c1+1):
                    out[i][j]=pat[(i-r0)%ph][(j-c0)%pw]
    return out
'''
